item.title: DIA Lasernet Testnet is Live!
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
DIA has launched Lasernet on testnet, introducing the world’s first Layer-2 rollup purpose-built for oracle infrastructure, combining trustless execution with scalability.

We’re thrilled to announce the launch of DIA Lasernet on testnet — the world’s first Layer-2 rollup built specifically for oracle infrastructure. Powered by industry-leading technologies like Optimism’s OP Stack, Conduit, Hyperlane, and Celestia, Lasernet promises scalable, trustless, and decentralized oracle data delivery for the future of Web3.

Developers, this is your chance to get hands-on with cutting-edge oracle tech! Test pull and push-based oracles on Ethereum Sepolia ahead of our mainnet launch in Q1 2025.

Want to learn more? Dive into the full details on how Lasernet transforms oracle infrastructure and join us in shaping the future of decentralized data.

👉 Read the full announcement on our blog

item.title: Community AMA, September 2023
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recap of the September 2023 Community AMA, a monthly session where the DIA Team answers community questions and suggestions in the DIA Telegram Community Chat.

DIA is hosting a monthly Telegram AMA session with the core team. The aim of this monthly event is to improve direct communication between DIA and it’s community, by collecting community concerns and suggestions and having the DIA core team answer them.

Below is a recap of the September 2023 Community AMA that took place on Sep 5th, 2023. In this Community AMA, we had with us Samuel Brack, Co-Founder & CTO, and Anze Noc, Community & DAO Lead at DIA. Lets take a look at what was discussed:

How does DIA address the challenges related to scalability, update costs, and interoperability often associated with oracles?

Scalability, update costs, and interoperability are major challenges in the oracle ecosystem, and we’ve tailored our strategy to mitigate them effectively. With years of operational experience across various platforms, DIA has developed a robust set of oracles that are updated through containerized feeders operating independently. This architecture enables us to scale seamlessly to meet growing demand.

Regarding gas costs, we’ve adopted a model where the customer requesting the oracle service covers these fees. This not only streamlines the process but also makes it financially efficient, allowing us to focus on other aspects of our service.

Interoperability is another area where we excel. Given that many of the blockchains we work with are EVM-compatible, we benefit from the ability to use a shared codebase for most of our operations. In the few cases where we need to adapt to a unique environment, we have the expertise to develop oracles for different codebases. So, whether it’s Ethereum or another blockchain, we’ve got it covered.

How does DIA mitigate incorrect or manipulated data?

Data integrity is paramount to us. To address the issue of erroneous or manipulated data, we’ve implemented several layers of security. Firstly, our system uses outlier detection algorithms to identify anomalous data points, which are temporarily removed from evaluation for specific feeds. This ensures that our data remains accurate and trustworthy.

In addition, for decentralized exchange (DEX) sources, we use liquidity and volume filters. This helps us ensure that the data we gather and provide is not only accurate but also actionable.

Beyond these automated processes, we also have manual mitigation protocols and alarms in place, allowing us to act quickly should an unexpected issue arise.

Any upcoming initiatives to enhance DIA’s oracles?

Continual improvement is at the core of DIA’s philosophy. To stay at the forefront of the DeFi ecosystem, we’re implementing several new features. One such initiative is DEX pool monitoring with associated liquidity restrictions, which will allow us to track pools for abnormal behavior or liquidity issues.

We’re also developing an alerting system to notify us of price or pool deviations in real-time, enabling quick action. To further enhance the reliability of our data, we plan to employ on-chain guardians for DEX pools to verify whether the to-be-reported prices are in line with highly liquid markets.

Additionally, we’re aiming to expand the number of sources used in calculating a price feed and are working towards further decentralizing our feeders and data sources.

How does DIA envision its future ecosystem beyond DeFi and NFTs?

While DeFi and NFTs are significant focus areas, DIA envisions a much broader application of its oracles. For instance, we’re exploring opportunities to provide data for real-world assets (RWAs) and on-chain bridge attestations. This would enable a seamless interaction between blockchain-based systems and traditional financial assets, while bridge attestations will add to the much-needed transparency in the interoperability space. We’re also working on providing foreign exchange (FX) data feeds for emerging markets to offer more comprehensive financial data services.

What are DIA’s thoughts on integrating Zero-Knowledge Proofs?

Zero-Knowledge Proofs (zkProofs) offer an exciting frontier for enhancing the privacy and scalability of blockchain networks. We’re in the exploratory phase of how to incorporate this technology into our stack. While it’s still early days, we believe zkProofs have the potential to bring significant advancements in both data integrity and confidentiality for oracles.

Can you give some insight into the DIA bounty program?

In light of market uncertainties, our focus is squarely on initiatives and roles that add immediate value to our core operation. Our DAO encompasses a variety of roles, such as community hub operation, content creation, and research, among others.

While we are vigilant about managing growth to avoid bloating operating costs, we are optimistic about the future. Once market conditions stabilize and interest rekindles, we’re geared to scale, launching more marketing and community initiatives as well as ramping up content production.

What’s DIA’s growth strategy? Established chains or emerging ones?

Our strategy is twofold: to consolidate our presence on established chains and to be pioneers on emerging, innovative networks. A prime example of this approach was our early deployment on Astar, which allowed us to become a go-to oracle solution for developers there. Our main value proposition lies in our rapid deployment capabilities, the high degree of customizability we offer, and our transparent approach to data sources.

Looking ahead, we aim to expand our footprint to over 40 established and emerging Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks, becoming an even more versatile and ubiquitous oracle solution.

Any job openings at DIA?

Yes, we’re actively recruiting for a specific position! We’re particularly keen on finding a Lead Web3 QA Engineer to join our core development team. For more details and application instructions, you can visit this link.

If you have skills that can contribute to DIA’s growth, we invite you to join one of our DAO guilds. You can find out more about how to apply on our DIA DAO bounty board.

Have questions for the DIA core team? Submit the questions here and get featured in the next AMA in October 2023: https://forms.gle/cUDRwuEDm6UUHPWe6

About DIA

DIA is a multi-chain, end-to-end, open-source data and oracle platform for Web3. DIA’s data is directly sourced from a broad array of on-chain and off-chain sources at individual trade-level. This allows DIA feeds to be fully customized regarding the mix of sources and methodologies, resulting in tailor-made, high-resilience feeds and thereby setting a new paradigm for oracles.

item.title: Community AMA, May 2023
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recap of the May 2023 Community AMA, a monthly session where the DIA Team answers community questions and suggestions in the DIA Telegram Community Chat.

DIA is hosting a monthly Telegram AMA session with the core team. The aim of this monthly event is to improve direct communication between DIA and it’s community, by collecting community concerns and suggestions and having the DIA core team answer them.

Below is a recap of the May 2023 Community AMA that took place on May 2nd, 2023. In this Community AMA, we had with us Zygis Marazas, Product Lead, and Mikel Garcia, Content Lead at DIA. Lets take a look at what was discussed:

  1. Congrats on the recent integrations with zkSync and zkEVM. Is there a plan to get more involved in the ZK space and how?
We are really excited and determined to continue building in the ZK space. There are two streams where we are focusing to explore more opportunities:
Supporting dapps and protocols in the ZK ecosystem by providing reliable access to our data offering. We are already noticing lots of interest from dApp developers launching their protocols on zkSync and zkEVM.
Integrating ZKPs (Zero Knowledge Proofs) into our own data pipeline to ensure trust and safety of the data. Can’t specify all the details but you might have noticed that we are actively working with other protocols, such as Mina on how to make ZKPs an active part of our infrastructure.

2. Is DIA planning to take part in any hackathons and to what extent? Usually these are great for attracting new developers in the community…

Absolutely! We know how important hackathons are to the development of the ecosystem and our industry. Hackathons provide an excellent opportunity to onboard new developers to the ecosystem.
Just as an example, in a few weeks time, we will be supporting an Evmos hackathon providing a few demo oracles for price feeds and random number generation. We will share more information on this in the coming days.
Additionally, we are exploring other hackathons for the broader Web3 ecosystem that we will also be sharing in the coming weeks.

3. Can you share a bit more details about the nature of the latest partnership with Silo Finance, and to what extent they are going to be using DIA’s oracles?

Silo Finance (Arbitrum) is a non-custodial lending protocol that facilitates borrowing any crypto asset with another. While DIA’s oracles play a crucial role in lending and borrowing dApps, providing the protocols with real-time price information of digital assets. These price feeds enable lending features such as determining the market value of collateral or loans, enforcing over-collateralization rules to protect lenders and more.
Silo Finance was looking to expand their lending markets offering and decided to put its trust in DIA’s transparent price oracles. The integration was subject to a governance vote and the Silo community voted overwhelmingly in favour of this development, with 99% of the votes supporting the proposal.
We are really excited to continue building with Silo and other similar protocols!
More details about our partnerships with Silo Finance: https://medium.com/dia-insights/partnership-with-silo-finance-powering-jones-lending-markets-on-arbitrum-340a1528fdbb

4. I am a regular listener of both DAO talks and also joined the Liquid Dialogues episode with guests from LST protocols. Are these events planned to continue and what is the purpose of those as most guests have no relation with DIA?

Indeed we are not actively working with all organizations we host events with, but as some topics such as liquid staking and governance continue to gain importance, we see the need to bring together relevant market actors in the field, share knowledge and create synergy with a wider community. Previous editions of these talks had a very high interest and engagement with over 1000 listeners each, so yes, we will continue organising more!
In regards to Liquid Dialogues, it started as an extension of our Ultimate Liquid Staking Map, which was created by the DIA DAO Community, to further position DIA within the liquid staking arena and connect LST projects. In the latest edition, we had renowned projects of the likes of Bifrost, Marinade Finance, pStake, Stader and Geode joining in. It ended up being a very engaging and insightful session for both users and developers. We are already excited for the next one!
The DIA DAO community is doing an outstanding job creating content, organising panels and more. Definitely recommend following the account on Twitter: https://twitter.com/DIACommunityHub

5. Is DIA planning to announce more partnerships with projects on Arbitrum, similar to FactorDAO? Is there a plan to get more exposure to the Arbitrum ecosystem, given the growth in on-chain activity there?

Really excited that Arbitrum managed to attract the attention of developers with its major features such as High EVM compatibility, low cost and a high-growth ecosystem.
DIA has been in the ecosystem for a while already and we have been expanding our infrastructure to cater the needs of this growing ecosystem. As a result, we have integrated Arbitrum-native DEXs in the past weeks, including Uniswap, Sushiswap, Curve and Camelot DEXs.
In addition, our research and deployments continue to ensure that the DIA Platform and its products reach more developers. As a result, with strong price oracle coverage within the ecosystem, we are uniquely positioning DIA within the ecosystem and it is leading to a nice influx of oracle requests from dApps.

6. Is your team planning to or already using AI for your operations? Not just for development but also for marketing and communication? What do you feel is the main benefit and risk of the rise of AI?

Yes, we believe that AI can be used in many different ways, especially to boost productivity, improve the quality of the output and automate certain processes.
We are currently researching different AI tools and testing them for various cases for each department within DIA. We are already using ChatGPT and a few other tools in our day-to-day operations and we already saw a significant efficiency improvement in content creation, brainstorming, research, operations and more.
Once our research is completed, we might share the findings with the community.

7. Is there any plan to have more video content? If so, what kind? I believe video content is much more effective than written content.

We absolutely agree! Right now we are focusing on using video format to communicate technical information in a more approachable way. For example, we do have a series where DIA developers explain the technicalities behind our core products in front of the camera. We also upload to YouTube, the recordings of events and panels where DIA participated.
In the future, we also want to focus on more videos geared towards community building and brand awareness. We are excited about what the community has in mind — it would be very interesting to see community-produced content on DIA as well.
Subscribe to our YT channel and check out all our videos: https://www.youtube.com/@DIAdata_org

8. Hi, what can you share about the current status of tokenomics of DIA? I am interested in token unlocks, top holders and updates, etc.

Hi, you can find all tokenomics-related updates and definitions in our Transparency report https://medium.com/dia-insights/transparency-report-1f61493ed9e5
It is continuously updated and the last update was about 1,5 months ago. We have exciting future plans, which will also be reflected there, so make sure to revisit it from time to time!

item.title: Hello Base: DIA’s Oracle Infrastructure Available on Base Mainnet
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
Marking the launch day of Base’s mainnet, DIA announces the integration of its data library with the networks. The deployment brings price feeds for 3k+ tokens, 18k+ NFT collections, and more to developers building on Base.

Introducing Base

Base is an innovative, secure, and cost-effective Ethereum Layer 2 solution built by Coinbase. By offering an Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) environment at a fraction of the cost of Ethereum, Base enables developers to effortlessly onboard and secure user assets from ETH Mainnet and smoothly interoperate with other L2 chains.

Powered by the MIT-licensed, open-source OP Stack and developed in collaboration with Optimism, Base is building towards the vision of bringing the next billion users onchain.

“Reliable data is the lifeblood of the onchain ecosystem — without it, some of the most significant use cases such as NFTs or DeFi couldn’t exist. We’re super excited to collaborate with DIA to make high-quality price feeds available for devs building on Base mainnet, helping them stretch their imaginations and what they can build.” — Jesse Pollak, Base Lead

Providing DIA’s Data Library on Base

We are delighted to announce that DIA’s comprehensive data library is now available on Base mainnet. This deployment makes price feeds for over 3,000+ tokens, 18,000+ NFT collections, and more to become accessible to developers on Base.

Multi-Source, Customisable, and Transparent Oracle Architecture

DIA distinguishes itself in the Web3 data landscape with its transparent, customisable and cross-chain oracle infrastructure. DIA not only provides standard asset price feeds for blue-chip tokens but also allows the creation of fully custom, on-demand oracles for lesser-known tokens to address sophisticated use cases. To accommodate these needs, DIA fetches trade data directly from over 80+ onchain and offchain sources across 30+ L1/L2s and can swiftly integrate new exchanges on demand.

This granular data availability enables highly customisable token and NFT price feeds. All feeds are adjustable in terms of pricing methodologies, source markets and pair pools, oracle update mechanism, and frequency. Additionally, per demand, DIA also develops unique pricing methodologies and oracle logics for the special use cases.

This ensures that the data and oracle remain robust and resilient to the market conditions and provide a global market as well as specific individual or cross-chain market prices. DIA’s battle-tested oracle architecture already powers 100+ dApps, unlocking unique use cases across DeFi, NFTfi and GameFi verticals.

Looking for a Custom Oracle on Base?

Get in touch with the DIA team via Telegram or Discord to start the process of requesting a fully customisable price oracle tailored for your use case. Find out more about the request process in the DIA documentation linked below:

→ Request an oracle — DIA Documentation

Base DIA Oracle Showcase

For developers looking to test DIA oracles, we have deployed a DIA demo oracle on the Base mainnet. Developers can interact with the following demo oracle smart contract:

  • Mainnet: 0xB8BF9ba432282F25F56e143641145349ab7c5Bf6
  • Testnet: 0x1BCBF8AbC9E2784e472548BE680d3f281F212A59

Note: DIA Demo Oracle contracts are not designed for live dApp integration. DIA assigns dedicated contracts for dApps, and we encourage you to request a dedicated oracle. Gain more insights on DIA demo oracles in the DIA documentation.

FAQ

What is DIA?

DIA is a cross-chain, data, and oracle platform that reimagines blockchain oracles across 30+ Layer1/Layer2 networks. DIA’s price oracles offer unmatched asset coverage, full customisation, and absolute transparency. DIA is creating innovative Web3 concepts for DeFi, NFTfi, and GameFi.

What is Base?

Base is a safe, low-cost, and developer-centric Ethereum L2 solution fostered by Coinbase to onboard the next billion users onchain. Base aims to gradually decentralise in the coming years.

How do DIA oracles operate?

DIA collects trading data directly from 80+ offchain and onchain sources to build price oracles. This approach ensures that protocols can access precise and reliable data feeds with complete transparency.

What are the advantages of using DIA oracles on Base?

Developers working on the Base mainnet can now access fully transparent and customisable price oracles for an extensive range of assets and NFT collections, including top digital assets. This enables the development of a wider range of DeFi and NFTfi applications.

About DIA

DIA redefines oracles on 30+ L1/L2s: Fully customisable, unmet asset coverage, 100% transparent. Enabling new primitives for DeFi, NFTfi and GameFi.

DIA’s data feeds are fully customized with regards to the mix of sources and methodologies, resulting in tailor-made, high-resilience feeds and thereby setting a new paradigm for oracles.

item.title: Community AMA, August 2023
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recap of the August 2023 Community AMA, a monthly session where the DIA Team answers community questions and suggestions in the DIA Telegram Community Chat.

DIA is hosting a monthly Telegram AMA session with the core team. The aim of this monthly event is to improve direct communication between DIA and it’s community, by collecting community concerns and suggestions and having the DIA core team answer them.

Below is a recap of the August 2023 Community AMA that took place on Aug 8th, 2023. In this Community AMA, we had with us Dillon Hanson, BD Manager, and Anze Noc, Community & DAO Lead at DIA. Lets take a look at what was discussed:

What was DIA’s participation in ETH CC like? What activities did happen, and what benefits will DIA reap from the events?

DIA’s participation in ETH CC was highly productive and engaging. We took part in the conference in many different ways:
First, we organized a private dinner with prominent Web3 builders in collaboration with Crypto Nomads Club, providing a conducive environment for networking and idea sharing.
During the main ETH CC conference, we participated in several panel discussions including a panel on Liquid Staking with industry leaders. This allowed us to share our insights with the community and learn from other experts in the field.
One of the highlights was co-hosting “Infra Gardens,” a successful side event focused on blockchain infrastructure, with esteemed teams from leading Web3 companies such as Polygon, zkSync, Cosmos, Gnosis, Celo, Protocol Labs, and many more.
Our participation at ETH CC allowed us to forge new connections and gain valuable industry insights. We established fruitful relationships with various founders, developers, and stakeholders in the blockchain industry, propelling our business development efforts forward. Additionally, we got a grasp of the upcoming trends, enabling us to adapt our products to best fit the evolving market.

I saw that DIA hosted a side event during ETH CC with a few other teams. What was the topic and outcome?

DIA hosted the side event named “Infra Gardens” during ETH CC, in collaboration with teams from Fractal ID, Fabric Ventures, Phala, and Protocol Labs. The focus of the event was on blockchain infrastructure and its significance for the entire ecosystem. It provided a platform for blockchain professionals, protocol teams, and L1/L2 builders to come together, network, and share knowledge.
The event featured four panels with guest speakers from well-known projects, including Polygon, zkSync, Near, Gnosis, Addressable, and Celo, among others. These discussions offered valuable insights into various aspects of blockchain infrastructure. We will be sharing panel recordings on our Youtube and Twitter page in the following weeks, make sure to check them out as lot’s of useful and relevant information was shared in a very interesting and engaging format.
“Infra Gardens” was a resounding success, attracting over 1000 participants and being hailed as one of the standout side events of ETH CC. The event served as an exceptional opportunity for DIA to connect with key industry stakeholders and strengthen our position in the blockchain community. Based on the positive response and impact, we plan to host similar events during other significant conferences in the future.
We are uploading all panels from Infra Gardens to our YouTube channel, so feel free to watch them: https://www.youtube.com/@DIAdata_org/

How many projects are targeted to participate in the Arbitrum Gasdrop campaign?

The Arbitrum Gasdrop campaign is currently open for projects to apply, and we have allocated 30,000 $ARB for this purpose. Each successful applicant will receive 1000 $ARB as part of the gasdrop.
We expect the campaign’s activity to pick up in the coming months, leading to new partnerships between DIA and protocols building on Arbitrum. For detailed information on the gasdrop campaign and participation process, please visit the provided link: https://www.diadata.org/oracle-gasdrop-arbitrum-grant/

I’ve come across the DIA App on your website and was wondering what is the main purpose of these feeds, sources, and information provided there?

The DIA App is designed to showcase the various supported tokens, data sources, and other essential information to build new, custom DIA oracles. Within the app, users can explore over 3000 tokens, 18,000 NFT collections, and LSD feeds. Moreover, it offers insights into 80+ supported data sources, revealing where DIA fetches pricing data from, including CEXs, DEXs, and NFT marketplaces.
We recently enhanced the app by providing additional information on the most popular available price feeds, optimizing it for SEO and educational purposes.
Furthermore, the DIA App includes a “Feed Builder” feature, allowing users to create custom price feeds. This self-service tool enables them to select the asset, included sources, and methodology for calculating the price feed, resulting in an instant API endpoint and the ability to request the feed as an oracle.
Additionally, the DIA App incorporates the “System Monitor,” offering real-time monitoring of DIA’s platform modules. It serves as a comprehensive resource hub for users to stay informed about DIA’s oracles and data services. To explore the DIA App, please visit: https://www.diadata.org/app

Do you guys at DIA have any plans on onboarding real-world data manually, by some sort of validators (in opposition to IoT data gathering)? If so, what’s the approach?

With an eye on constant innovation and a commitment to staying at the forefront of blockchain technology, we are excited about the boundless potential that Real World Assets hold in shaping the future of finance and beyond.
Our team at DIA is actively exploring the different opportunities and roles that we can play in bringing Real World Asset information on chain. By becoming a reliable oracle for RWA’s, we can empower dApps and blockchain projects to access accurate and verified data on real-world assets, fostering a new era of transparency and trust.
In addition, we are also focused on partnering with various dApps and blockchain foundations which are focused on Real World Assets and collectively working with such teams to more specifically define the support we can provide as an oracle. While our exact strategy and approach for delivering this data on-chain is still being defined, it is certainly something we are focused on, and we believe Real World Assets will continue to grow in importance and adoption within the blockchain ecosystem.

Are there any plans on proposing a reward to the CAR voters this year as you guys did last year?

Similar to last year, we will allow the community to propose the measures for the usage of the unlocked DIA tokens. Same as every year, we plan to allocate a period during which the community can submit proposals on how the unlocked tokens should be utilized. We welcome suggestions and will evaluate the proposals, presenting the chosen options for a DAO vote, allowing the community to validate them.
More information and communication on this matter will be provided before the end of the year (November/December).

I have found the Zealy Quests to be personally rewarding. Has there been a noticeable benefit for DIA’s business ventures with the community performing these quests? Is there a projected duration of using Zealy?

We are delighted to hear that you find Zealy (previously Crew3) personally rewarding! Zealy has indeed proven to be an invaluable tool for community building and fostering collaborations. By engaging our community in Zealy sprints, which has now grown to over 1000 members, we have received valuable feedback, content, and ideas from active participants.
Additionally, Zealy has facilitated seamless community collaborations with other projects, allowing us to track individual contributions efficiently. Its gamified approach makes the contribution process enjoyable and rewarding for participants. Not only does Zealy help us scale our community and marketing processes effectively, it also provides a simple-to-use platform for anyone that wants to get involved and actively contribute towards the DIA community.
We plan to continue leveraging Zealy in our community-building efforts and are always open to feedback and ideas to enhance its effectiveness further.

What are the benefits of engaging with the DIA community on different platforms like Discord and other portals? How can community members actively contribute and collaborate?

The community is the cornerstone of any Web3 company. As a B2B company, building a strong community presents unique challenges, as our products are not directly accessible to token holders and community members. However, we understand that a robust community is essential for reputation, brand awareness, and marketing.
Engaging with the DIA community on various platforms, including Discord and TG, provides several benefits. Community members can actively contribute and collaborate in several ways:
Participating in Zealy sprints offers a chance to earn monthly rewards and provide valuable input.
Joining the DIA DAO allows members to contribute their skills to tasks supporting our core operations and earn $ETH in the process
Supporting DIA on social media helps increase our reach and exposure to relevant projects and individuals in the space.
Submitting proposals in the DIA DAO forum suggests new projects and initiatives for consideration.
Actively participating in community discussions on Discord and TG fosters knowledge exchange and networking.
Participating in the DAO votes using $DIA tokens resulted in a airdrop in the previous year
Every contribution is valued and noticed, and we are always on the lookout for talented individuals to help us achieve our goals. While not all activities are incentivized in the same manner, we thrive to reward the most valuable contributions that really support our core mission. Incentives vary based on the complexity of the contribution, market environment and other indices.

item.title: Partnership with NEOKingdom DAO
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
We are delighted to announce that DIA has deployed a bespoke price oracle for the EUR and USDC assets on Evmos to power the off-ramping of NEOKingdom DAO tokens.

Introducing NEOKingdom DAO

NEOKingdom DAO’s vision is to reimagine employment by facilitating both web3 and real-world businesses to become DAOs. Investors can invest money and contributors can invest time to receive tokens of the DAO. These NEOK tokens give access to ownership, governance, and dividend rights. Every contributor is an owner and has a voice in governance decisions, and rights to profits. Contributors also have the flexibility to liquidate their NEOK tokens for fiat money. NEOKingdom DAO is a legally-compliant DAO under the favourable Estonian legal system.

DIA Oracles to Power NEOKingdom DAO

We are delighted to announce a partnership with NEOKingdom DAO. With a shared vision of transparency, scalability, and customizability, we have co-developed a bespoke price oracle deployed on the Evmos network. The oracle provides real-time price feeds for the EUR/USD and USDC/USD asset pairs. This oracle enables the automatic conversion required for NEOKingdom DAO contributors to convert their NEOK tokens to Euros.

The feed is constructed by leveraging single trade data for each asset, sourced from multiple high-volume exchanges. Following this, DIA implements rigorous data-cleansing filters and fully transparent pricing methodologies, delivering a highly accurate and reliable final price feed.

See the sources for each asset in the following links:

  • EUR source markets
  • USDC source markets

Learn more about how DIA oracles work in our documentation.

Launching a EUR and USDC Oracle on Evmos

The NEOKingdom team commented on the use case of the custom oracle, saying, “One core feature of our project is to enable DAO contributors to buy and sell NEOK tokens in what we refer to as the ‘internal market’. Contributors use the internal market to sell their NEOK for EUR. At the moment, there are no EUR stablecoins on Evmos, and when a contributor buys NEOK from another contributor, they have to use USDC for this type of transaction. In order to convert USDC to EUR, the internal market needs access to a price feed (oracle). We weren’t able to find the price feeds we needed, which is why we contacted DIA. Not only did DIA immediately deploy the oracle to Evmos, but they also helped us to understand and improve our integration with it.”

The oracle has been deployed with a custom update mechanism, pushing the latest price data on-chain every 60 minutes. This design best serves the particular needs of using the price oracle as a means of enabling NEOK to USDC conversion on-chain.

NEOKingdom DAO has not only transparently requested but also made these configuration settings available to the public in the DIA Forum. In addition, they have endowed the oracle with sufficient funds to guarantee its operation for approximately a year, and have graciously offered its use as a public good to the wider Evmos community. item.title: Partnership with LINK Africa
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
DIA Joins Forces with LINK, a Web3 Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure for Africa, to Launch Nigeria’s First Parallel Market Price Oracle

Introducing LINK Africa

LINK Africa is a cutting-edge Web3 company that revolutionises cross-border payments for the next billion Africans. Offering the tools and the infrastructure for developers and businesses to build scalable cross-border payments use cases as well as leverage LINK’s end-to-end product utilizing complex blockchain technology presented in the simplest form for businesses ranging from on/off ramps looking to scale to the continent, to local savings platforms looking to provide USD and higher foreign currency yields, to every day businesses just looking for ways to pay and get paid globally.

LINK has indeed and is still building the infrastructure in bridging Africa’s Internet of value.

We are delighted to join forces with LINK in their mission, to launch the first market price oracle for the Naira, Nigeria’s local currency. Through this integration, the LINK Africa protocol gains access to real-time price information for the Nigerian Naira (NGN) on-chain. The oracle has been initially deployed on the Polygon network.

NGN API and Price Oracle — Naira

Emanuel Evarist, Co-Founder of LINK comments:

“The importance of this partnership can not be overemphasized, the DIA team has helped put part of the building blocks for us to bring global foreign exchange interoperability onchain especially with a heavy remittance and crypto market like Nigeria, indeed as simple as a price feed is to other markets — for us this pushes a nudge further towards our misson, today leveraging the power of infrastructure users both business and individuals alike can perform NGN/USD fx onchain without the need of intermediaries in a decentralized way”

Powering a Cross-Border Payments Infrastructure

Africa faces a significant market problem, characterised by high fees, poor/multiple exchange rates, and slow settlement times for financial transactions. In response, LINK developed a payment infrastructure using blockchain technology. Another important piece of this infrastructure, which was crucial for smart contract transaction execution, required a blockchain oracle to deliver a price feed with the latest exchange rate of the Nigerian Naira.

As no other oracle was capable of providing such a feed, LINK collaborated with DIA to realise the project. DIA promptly deployed a custom feed for LINK, creating the first price oracle for the Nigerian Naira. This price feed is meticulously constructed by fetching trade data from digital asset exchanges and applying cleansing filters and price-determining methodologies.

Adoption and Usage of the Oracle

Excitingly, the oracle has already been integrated into several dApps, including DFX Finance. DFX Finance is a decentralised foreign exchange (FX) protocol optimised for trading fiat-backed foreign stablecoins. The oracle powers an NGN/USD pool, live on the Polygon network. For more details on the pool’s launch, please refer to the thread below:

DFX Finance on Twitter: "Happy Monday, Dragons! 🐉Today we are excited to announce not only our 10th fiat-backed foreign stablecoin to be added to the #DFX protocol but also, the FIRST Nigerian stablecoin (#NGNC) available on #Polygon! 👏 🥹🧵👇 pic.twitter.com/6GN0iCvkxm / Twitter"

Happy Monday, Dragons! 🐉Today we are excited to announce not only our 10th fiat-backed foreign stablecoin to be added to the #DFX protocol but also, the FIRST Nigerian stablecoin (#NGNC) available on #Polygon! 👏 🥹🧵👇 pic.twitter.com/6GN0iCvkxm

A Transparent Delivery

The NGN price oracle has been deployed with custom configurations as per LINK’s requests, ensuring seamless integration with the dApps utilising the oracle. LINK has transparently requested and made these configuration settings publicly available in the DIA Forum:

→ CDR #035: Link | NGN Price Feed

In conclusion, the partnership between LINK and DIA marks a transformative moment in the history of cross-border payments in Africa. It paves the way for a future where individuals and businesses can thrive on a level playing field, unrestricted by geographical boundaries or legacy financial systems. As we witness this exciting chapter unfold, let us embrace the potential it holds and work together to build a more prosperous and inclusive Africa.

item.title: Partnership with zkFinance
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
zkFinance has officially integrated DIA oracles on zkFinance to power the deployment of new money markets based on high-quality and reliable asset price feeds.

Introducing zkFinance

zkFinance is a one-stop DeFi solution that leverages zkSync technology to offer cheaper, faster, and more secure transactions. It provides an immutable money market on-chain through zero-knowledge proofs, which enhances security and privacy. Users can trade, stake, and pool various tokens. The platform is designed to be user-friendly and accessible to everyone, regardless of their technical expertise or financial status.

We are delighted to announce that zkFinance has officially integrated DIA oracles into its platform on zkSync. zkFinance users can now benefit from reliable and accurate price feeds for different digital assets. The oracle, customized to meet the specific requirements of the dApp, ensure optimal performance. The incorporation of DIA oracles empowers zkFinance to safely deploy new money markets based on high-quality and highly reliable asset price feeds, enhancing the overall functionality and reliability of zkFinance and providing users with a seamless DeFi experience.

“Having a reliable stream of prices is of utmost importance for zkFinance as this gives confidence to our users that prices are accurate and can’t be manipulated. As a result, users can be highly confident that the money markets accurately reflect market conditions. This is another milestone in our path to provide a high quality product based in zkSync. We are truly excited to work together with DIA Oracles”

Pedro Isaac Lopez — zkFinance Co-Founder & COO

The Crucial Role of Price Oracles in On-Chain Money Markets

Price oracles play a pivotal role in on-chain money markets, primarily due to their contribution to the accurate valuation of assets. These markets involve a diverse range of assets, each with its unique value. Price oracles offer real-time, reliable market prices for these assets, enabling their precise valuation. This is particularly vital in lending and borrowing platforms within the DeFi ecosystem, where loans are collateralized by these assets.

Without the accurate price information provided by oracles, assessing the value of collateral correctly becomes challenging, potentially leading to imbalances in the lending and borrowing process. Hence, price oracles are fundamental in maintaining the integrity and smooth operation of on-chain money markets.

zkSync’s DIA Custom Oracle: Ensuring Accurate Asset Valuation

DIA has developed a customized price oracle for zkFinance, configured to provide price data for several assets, including USDC, USDT, BUSD, DAI, ETH and more. The feeds are built by utilising market data from 80+ high-volume centralised and decentralised exchanges. The price calculation methodology employed is the Moving Average Price with Interquartile Range (MAIR), which aggregates three resulting prices using a volume-weighted average.

To ensure the accuracy and relevance of the data, a 1% deviation threshold for updates trigger has been set for each asset. If the price of an asset deviates by more than 1% from the previous value, the oracle triggers an update. In the absence of any deviation-based updates, the feed is refreshed every 24 hours.

A Transparent, Custom Oracle Delivery

DIA deployed a dedicated and tailor-made oracle to supply zkFinance with the most optimal price feeds. The oracle is designed with custom parameters, such as source markets, price determination methodology, update mechanism, etc. These configurations facilitate the zkFinance team with the most suitable oracle for its unique money market use case.

These requirements were transferred to DIA by submitting a DIA Custom Delivery Request (CDR) via the DIA Forum which is publicly available to everyone.

→ CDR #053: zkFinance | Token Price Feed on zkSync

Custom Oracle Solutions for zkSync Developers

If you’re a developer in the zkSync ecosystem and need a custom oracle solution, we’re here to assist. Our team at DIA has experience in creating tailored solutions, as demonstrated in our work with zkFinance. Feel free to reach out to us via the DIA Forum, Discord or Telegram.

item.title: Partnership with Qoda
item.dc:creator: DIA Core Team
item.content:encoded:
We are excited to announce that Qoda has officially integrated DIA’s oracle feeds into its lending and borrowing platform. This integration amplifies Qoda’s commitment to expanding the range of crypto assets available for use, transforming the way digital assets are used in DeFi.

Unveiling Qoda

Qoda is a decentralized loan exchange with several key features such as an on-chain order book for lending/borrowing, isolated collateral-tier vs market-tier assets, repayment redemption ratio and many more. These features give users more control and flexibility over their crypto portfolio.

Qoda aims to broaden the spectrum of crypto assets used in lending/borrowing beyond popular assets like USDC, ETH, and BTC. Its pursuit of this goal has led to a fruitful collaboration with DIA, an oracle provider specializing in the creation of reliable price oracles for long-tail assets.

We are excited to announce that Qoda has officially integrated DIA’s oracle feeds into its platform. This integration gives Qoda access to a diverse array of on-chain price data, enabling users to deposit collateral, lend, and borrow assets typically unavailable on other fixed-income dApps.

Qoda’s Oracle Integration

To support a broad range of digital assets on its platform, Qoda requires accurate and real-time data feeds delivered on the Moonbeam network as an oracle smart contract. Hence, the integration of DIA oracles includes:

Live Price Feeds for Digital Assets

Qoda’s smart contracts use DIA’s oracle feeds to obtain up-to-date and accurate price data for a diverse range of assets including ASTR, ACA, and D2O. This ensures the proper accounting of risk and enhances Qoda’s creditworthiness as users must over-collateralize to initiate borrow positions in our markets.

Customizable Data Feeds for Diverse Assets

DIA’s oracle feeds provide Qoda with a fully transparent and customizable oracle solution. This arrangement enables Qoda to tailor the feeds to best match their application’s needs and to build resilient price feeds for the selected tokens. For more information on the implementation of the oracle, please visit the Custom Delivery Request that Qoda published on the DIA Forum:

CDR #050: Qoda Finance | Price Feed on Moonbeam

Qoda’s Future Growth

Qoda is committed to continually broadening its asset offerings and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of its data. This partnership with DIA underscores this commitment, enhancing Qoda’s functionality and creating more opportunities for users.
